title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
description:
arXiv:2610.37739v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics.
